comment: Registry of external MCP servers the plugin knows about. Activation requires explicit user opt-in (Claude Code must have the MCP server connected). The curator skill adds new entries; the plugin never installs MCP servers automatically.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.description: Drives Chrome via DevTools Protocol — page navigation, screenshots, console messages, network requests, Lighthouse audits, performance traces.
servers.use_case_in_pipeline: Stage 7 critic for UI features — run lighthouse + smoke screenshots after the wirer fires.

servers.name: Gmail
servers.description: Read and search Gmail. Useful for features that need email-style data (notifications, templated emails, communication flows).
servers.use_case_in_pipeline: Reference reading only — when generating email-sending features, look at real Gmail message structure as ground truth.

servers.name: Supabase
servers.description: Read schema / query data from Supabase projects. Useful when the user's target is a Supabase-backed app and we need to know the actual schema.
servers.use_case_in_pipeline: Stage 1 scanner extension — when codebase_graph detects a Supabase client, consult the actual schema via MCP instead of guessing from migrations.

servers.name: Vercel
servers.description: Read Vercel project state — deployments, env vars, logs. Useful when wiring features into a Vercel-hosted app.
servers.use_case_in_pipeline: Stage 6 wirer extension — verify the generated routes don't clash with existing edge functions before mutating the project.
